theorem_title: Source-host storage is charged to encoder count
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandHostCosts.space_le_encoderCount {base NL NR n p U D : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hNL : NL ≤ n) (hNR : NR ≤ n) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceBandHost.space base NL NR (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandScales.bandSize n) p
      (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.microHalf (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.blockCount (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n) U D ≤
      base+(29+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.blockCount (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)+_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBanksCosts.storageFactor n)*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StageBounds.encoderCount n+
        Nat.log 2 (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.TrimScales.scheduleCount n+1)+
        max (Nat.log 2 (U+1)+2) (Nat.log 2 (p+D+1)+2)+16 := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $n>0$, original source lengths $N_L,N_R\le n$, base address $b$, and natural controls $p,U,D$. Using the executable band width and local parameters, the exact source-host space is at most $$b+(29+J+F(n))E(n)+\lfloor\log_2(S(n)+1)\rfloor+\max(\lfloor\log_2(U+1)\rfloor+2,\lfloor\log_2(p+D+1)\rfloor+2)+16,$$ where $J$ is block count, $F$ storage factor, $E$ encoder count, and $S$ schedule count.

Keeps the absolute base affine while bounding the constructed source payload. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
